value: TGSM pointers must originate from an unambiguous TGSM global variable.
note: The reported symptom is a DXIL validation diagnostic, so the predicate quotes the validation RULE TEXT verbatim -- both because that is what the issue reports, and because `classify` only suppresses its invalid-probe demotion when a POSITIVE clause of match.json quotes a matched marker verbatim (SKILL.md, step 6). MEASURED CORRECTION: the first version of this predicate carried an "error: " prefix, copied from the reporter's 2024 paste. That prefix does not exist in v1.4.1907, which frames the same rule as 'at 0x2221ed5c658 inside block .lr.ph._crit_edge of function main TGSM pointers must originate from an unambiguous TGSM global variable.' -- no "error: ", an instruction address instead of the IR text, and no source line:column. The tight predicate scored v1.4.1907 no-repro and `bisect --linear` reported a transition at v1.5.2010 that does not exist. The falsifying capture is preserved in manual-case-predicate-correction.txt; see method-notes.md. Presence-only on purpose. Two further hazards ruled out by construction: (a) this is not an absence predicate, so it cannot be satisfied for free by a compile that never started; (b) the diagnostic's own note: line ECHOES the rejected IR back into stderr -- "note: at '%13 = phi float addrspace(3)* ...'" -- so any not_contains over phi, addrspace(3) or the global's name would be falsified by the error message itself. Deliberately NOT anchored on the phi: v1.4.1907 does not print the instruction at all, and a release whose optimizer merged the pointers with a select would be the same defect in a different instruction. That distinction is caught instead by match-compile-fails.json. NOT internal_failure: a DXIL validation failure is an ordinary diagnosed error and exits E_FAIL (0x80004005) -- measured, see out-main-debug.txt. Controls: variant-od-* (the reporter's own -Od workaround) and variant-control-groupshared-*, both --expect no-match, so a predicate firing on any TGSM shader, or on any failing compile, would be caught.
